HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.
   B. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.
   D. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

3. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.
   C. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Linguistic groups in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Say Linguistic groups in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Linguistic groups in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

7. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   B. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.
   D. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   B. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.
   D. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.
   C. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

13. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.

14. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.

15. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.
   C. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   D. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to History and Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Linguistic groups in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Establishment of colonial rule and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Public Participation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Elections in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain National integration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Human Developments in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
